main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads a number of test cases; for each case, reads points, builds every line through pairs of points, groups lines by slope and intercept, counts unique points on each collinear group, applies a parity-based adjustment to obtain a per-slope maximum, and prints the largest result as the Case # answer." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a Scanner bound to System.in. RESULT input]
            [COMMAND Read the number of test cases T using input.nextInt(). RESULT T]
            [COMMAND For each turn from 0 to T-1, process one test case. RESULT turn]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, read the number of points n using input.nextInt(). RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, initialize an empty ArrayList to hold Point objects. RESULT points]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, for i from 0 to n-1, read two long coordinates using input.nextLong(), create a Point from them, and add it to points. RESULT points]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, initialize an empty ArrayList to hold Line objects. RESULT lines]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, for i from 0 to n-1 and for j from i+1 to n-1, create a Line from points[i] and points[j] and add it to lines. RESULT lines]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, initialize an empty HashMap map keyed by Double slope values and valued by ArrayList of Line objects. RESULT map]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, for each line in lines, if map does not contain the line's slope k, store a new ArrayList containing that line under key k; otherwise append the line to the existing ArrayList for key k. RESULT map]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, initialize an empty ArrayList to hold Integer results. RESULT results]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, iterate over the entries of map with an Iterator; each entry groups all lines having one slope. RESULT slope_group_loop]
            [COMMAND Within the slope group loop, initialize result to 0 and initialize an empty HashMap bmap keyed by Double intercept values and valued by ArrayList of Line objects. RESULT bmap]
            [COMMAND Within the slope group loop, for each line in the current slope group, if bmap does not contain the line's intercept b, store a new ArrayList containing that line under key b; otherwise append the line to the existing ArrayList for key b. RESULT bmap]
            [COMMAND Within the slope group loop, initialize an empty ArrayList to hold Integer values for this slope group. RESULT resultarray]
            [COMMAND Within the slope group loop, iterate over the entries of bmap with an Iterator; for each intercept group, collect all distinct Point objects from p1 and p2 of each Line in that group into a HashSet, then add the HashSet size to resultarray. RESULT resultarray]
            [COMMAND Within the slope group loop, compute sum as the total of all values in resultarray. RESULT sum]
            [COMMAND Within the slope group loop, set result based on sum and n: if sum is even and n - sum >= 2, set result to sum + 2; if sum is even and n - sum < 2, set result to n; if sum is odd and n - sum >= 1, set result to sum + 1; if sum is odd and n - sum < 1, set result to n. RESULT result]
            [COMMAND Within the slope group loop, append result to results. RESULT results]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop after all slope groups, initialize max to 1; if results is empty, max remains 1. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, for each value in results, if max is less than that value, set max to that value. RESULT max]
            [COMMAND Within the test case loop, print 'Case #' + (turn + 1) + ': ' + max. RESULT printed_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
